tools.name: get_sac_kpis
tools.description: Retrieve executive financial, operational, and strategic KPIs from SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).

domain.description: Domain of interest (e.g. FINANCE, OPERATIONS, WORKFORCE, STRATEGY). Default is FINANCE.

tools.name: get_sac_story_analytics
tools.description: Fetch high-level business intelligence story insights, charts, and variances from SAP Analytics Cloud.

story_id.description: Identifier of the SAC Story (e.g. VELORA_CORP_PERF_2026).

tools.name: get_sac_model_data
tools.description: Query data export model structures and aggregated metric values directly from SAP Analytics Cloud models.

model_id.description: Model ID in SAP Analytics Cloud.

measures.description: List of measure field names to query.
